name: Melanin biosynthesis and pigment granule localization
rationale: All members concern making melanin (melanin synthesis, MITF-M pigmentation genes, OCA6, secondary-metabolite regulation) or positioning pigment granules, unlike confusables centred on melanosome assembly, other MITF-M programs, organelle acidification or UV/melanocyte proliferation.

core: Mycobacterium tuberculosis manipulation of host cell
qualifier: nutrient acquisition and suppression of host defences
name: Mycobacterium tuberculosis nutrient acquisition and host defence suppression
rationale: Every member is an Mtb strategy of iron/heme acquisition, host metabolic and ion manipulation, or suppression of NO, apoptosis and autophagy, whereas confusables centre on blocking phagosome maturation, acidification and membrane repair.

name: Viral protein maturation and virion assembly
rationale: Members cover processing/maturation of viral structural proteins (spike, DENV proteins) and assembly at the budding site, while confusables cover viral attachment, entry and release.

qualifier: cystine supply and inherited enzyme defects
name: Glutathione gamma-glutamyl cycle, cystine supply and inherited defects
rationale: Members are glutathione synthesis, recycling, transport and catabolism with its precursor (cystine, glutamate) supply and gamma-glutamyl cycle enzyme deficiencies, distinct from transsulfuration/sulfur catabolism and broader ROS/redox confusables.

qualifier: BAX/BAK permeabilization, cytochrome c release, apoptosome
name: BAX/BAK pore formation, cytochrome c release and apoptosome activation
rationale: Members span outer-membrane permeabilization by BAX/BAK, cytochrome c and SMAC release, IAP neutralisation and apoptosome caspase activation, while confusables add the BH3-only activators BIM, BMF, NOXA, PUMA and BID.

name: Lung morphogenesis, alveolar differentiation and surfactant homeostasis
rationale: Members cover lung branching, lobe and saccule development, pneumocyte differentiation and surfactant metabolism with its genetic defects, unlike confusables centred on trachea, diaphragm, mesenchyme or other branching organs.

name: Cardiac depolarization and AV node-His-Purkinje conduction
rationale: All members concern the depolarizing phase of cardiomyocyte action potentials and conduction through AV node, bundle of His and Purkinje fibres, whereas confusables cover repolarization phases, SA node pacemaking and gap-junction coupling.

qualifier: angiogenic growth factor production and sprouting promotion
name: Angiogenic growth factor production and sprouting angiogenesis promotion
rationale: Members regulate VEGF, FGF and TGF-beta2 production and positively drive sprouting, branching and endothelial proliferation, unlike confusables on Tie2/VEGFR2 receptor signaling, endothelial activation/apoptosis or negative regulation of sprouting.

name: Sweet, bitter and umami taste perception
rationale: All members are perception of sweet, bitter or umami tastes, which distinguishes the theme from sour-taste and olfaction confusables.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to RAS-MAPK and PI3K
name: ERBB, FGFR and MET receptor signaling to RAS-MAPK and PI3K
rationale: Members are RTK (mainly ERBB, FGFR, MET) adaptor cascades through SHC/GRB2/FRS/PLCG/PI3K to RAS-RAF-MAPK and AKT, including RAS/RAF point mutants and feedback, whereas confusables emphasise oncogenic RTK fusions/amplifications or ERK5/p38 branches.

name: Cellular redox homeostasis, NADPH supply and ferroptosis control
rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, NADPH regeneration via isocitrate metabolism, glutathione/cystine transport and pro- and anti-ferroptosis regulation, distinct from confusables on glutathione synthesis defects, NFE2L2 target programs and NAD/ascorbate metabolism.

name: Copper, manganese and cadmium transport and detoxification
rationale: All members concern copper, manganese or cadmium import, homeostasis or detoxification, separating the theme from zinc, iron/heme and metallothionein-response confusables.

qualifier: synthesis, vesicular loading and plasma-membrane reuptake
name: Catecholamine synthesis, vesicular loading and plasma-membrane reuptake
rationale: Members cover dopamine/norepinephrine synthesis, vesicular loading, release and SLC6 transporter reuptake (including DAT/NET defects), whereas confusables cover MAO/COMT degradation and serotonin synthesis.

qualifier: GABA and glycine synthesis, release and reuptake
name: GABA and glycine inhibitory neurotransmitter synthesis and reuptake
rationale: Members are GABA synthesis, secretion, reuptake and degradation plus glycinergic transmission, distinguishing the theme from the glutamate/aspartate transport confusables.

name: TGF-beta SMAD2/3 signaling and miRNA biogenesis regulation
rationale: Members cover TGF-beta receptor and SMAD2/3:SMAD4 transcriptional signaling and its down-regulation plus SMAD-linked miRNA transcription and processing, unlike confusables on fibrosis, RUNX3, TGFBR3/activin or BMP.

qualifier: intraflagellar transport, ciliary targeting and motility
name: Cilium assembly, ciliary protein trafficking and motile cilia function
rationale: Members span centriole/basal body formation, intraflagellar transport, cargo targeting to cilia and motile cilia/flagella and their roles in CSF flow and left-right asymmetry, unlike confusables on photoreceptors, sperm mitochondrial sheath, tubulin modification or organ laterality.

qualifier: primitive streak EMT and mesendoderm migration
name: Gastrulation, primitive streak EMT and mesendoderm migration
rationale: Members describe gastrulation events (EMT, primitive streak, mesendoderm, mesodermal migration, germ layers) and pluripotency exit, while confusables concern definitive endoderm, cardiac or lateral plate mesoderm derivatives.

name: Norepinephrine and epinephrine biosynthesis
rationale: All three members concern synthesis and metabolism of norepinephrine and epinephrine, whereas confusables add dopamine synthesis, monoamine degradation and transport.

name: cAMP synthesis and degradation in dopamine-DARPP-32-CREB signaling
rationale: Members are adenylate cyclase activation, cAMP production and PDE breakdown with dopamine receptor, DARPP-32 and CREB outputs, distinct from confusables centred on PKA activation and cellular cAMP response.

name: Cardiac chamber, valve and septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover ventricular/atrial myocardium, trabeculation, endocardial cushion EMT, valves and septa, while confusables concern early heart tube, secondary heart field, coronary vessels or great arteries.

name: Replication stress response, DNA topology and telomere maintenance
rationale: Members cover replication fork reversal, intra-S checkpoint, topoisomerase/DNA topology, R-loops and telomere maintenance and capping, unlike confusables centred on double-strand break repair pathways.

core: Organic ion and xenobiotic membrane transport
name: Organic cation, polyamine and xenobiotic membrane transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated organic cation, polyamine and xenobiotic transport, whereas confusables emphasise organic anion SLCO/SLC22 transport, drug ADME and bilirubin handling.

name: Th2 cell differentiation, cytokine production and IL-4/IL-13 signaling
rationale: Members promote Th2 differentiation and IL-4/5/13 production and IL-4/IL-13 signaling, distinguishing the theme from eosinophil, IL-33 and negative-regulation confusables.

qualifier: JNK and p38 stress kinase output
name: Innate receptor TAK1 activation of JNK and p38 kinases
rationale: Members are TLR/TRIF/IRAK2/TRAF6 and ALPK1 routes to TAK1 activation and downstream JNK and p38 stress kinase signaling, while confusables focus on IKK recruitment and NF-kappaB activation.

name: Hexosamine biosynthesis and sialic acid metabolism
rationale: Members cover fructose-6-phosphate to UDP-GlcNAc synthesis, GlcNAc and sialic acid metabolism and their defects (GFPT1, GNE, ALG14), distinct from GDP-mannose, UDP-glucose and nucleotide-sugar transport confusables.
